'''Goss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Goss was part of a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Thaerian [[Spy/Legends|spies]] who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. When the Thaereian military arranged for the [[Death/Legends|assassination]] of the negotiator [[Gavid Lermyn]], Goss and his fellow Thaereians [[Huvi]], [[Jova (Thaereian)|Jova]], [[Kellam]], [[Scutt]] and [[Waals]] were sent to detain the [[Heroes of Cularin]] until after the assassination. Posing as members of the [[Cularin Militia]], the squad attempted to persuade the heroes to surrender to them.
